text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, Gimlet-dono. 'When two tigers 
clash.' How would you respond to such a 
phrase?”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—shall we simply call that 'amor fati'?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Yet as the ancients said, "To give 
leeway to an enemy for even a single day 
invites disaster for generations." How do 
you answer to that?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. The 'Kingdom of Lydia' and the like 
would be fitting recipients of that 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "If harmony cannot be attained 
within the army, one should not march out 
to form battle lines"... I see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Just like the God of Time, 
'Zurvan' ――Ngh!?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! You walked right into my trap! 
Victory is miiiine!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My, my. It seems I still have the upper 
hand in this game of "Idiom Shiritori"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... My "realm of words" is far from 
exhausted. It is far too early to 
intoxicate yourself with the sweet wine of 
victory...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I went library-hopping myself just 
to expand my vocabulary! I shall show you 
the overwhelming difference in our power!
